verdict.rationale: The GitHub README says users can add skills (and MCP servers) from the Library in Settings, and that every model sees the same skills, so the agent can be equipped with skills. That is one brief mention. It does not show whether developers can write their own custom skills or only pick from a provided library. Missing for 10: evidence of authoring or importing user-defined skills, documentation of the skill format, examples of specialized tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
